ability_strike.name: Piston Strike
ability_strike.description: A hydraulic-assisted arm strike. Standard issue, reliable output.

ability_shield_bash.name: Bulkhead Slam
ability_shield_bash.description: Ram your plating into the target, overloading their gyroscopes.

ability_whirlwind.name: Rotary Shred
ability_whirlwind.description: Engage rotational servos at max RPM, shredding everything in range.

ability_slam.name: Chassis Slam
ability_slam.description: Hurl your full tonnage into the floor, sending shockwaves through nearby units.

ability_feral_roar.name: Threat Broadcast
ability_feral_roar.description: Blast a high-decibel threat signal that scrambles enemy targeting.

ability_earthquake.name: Seismic Pound
ability_earthquake.description: Drive both fists into the arena floor. Structural integrity not guaranteed.

ability_arcane_bolt.name: Arc Discharge
ability_arcane_bolt.description: Fire a concentrated bolt of electrical energy from your core.

ability_frost_nova.name: Cryo Burst
ability_frost_nova.description: Vent coolant in a flash-freeze burst, locking nearby servos solid.

ability_meteor.name: Orbital Drop
ability_meteor.description: Call down a superheated payload from the arena ceiling. AXIS disapproves.

ability_backstab.name: Blind Spot Strike
ability_backstab.description: Exploit a gap in the target's sensor coverage for maximum damage.

ability_smoke_bomb.name: EMP Grenade
ability_smoke_bomb.description: Lob an electromagnetic pulse that scrambles sensors in the blast zone.

ability_assassinate.name: Core Breach
ability_assassinate.description: Puncture the target's core housing. 3x critical damage.

ability_dark_chord.name: Dissonance Pulse
ability_dark_chord.description: Emit a corrupted signal wave that damages all nearby units.

ability_raise_dead.name: Salvage Drone
ability_raise_dead.description: Reactivate a scrapped unit to fight on your behalf.

ability_death_ballad.name: Feedback Loop
ability_death_ballad.description: Broadcast a recursive signal that degrades enemy systems over time.

ability_flurry.name: Piston Flurry
ability_flurry.description: Rapid-fire piston punches. Quantity over quality.

ability_uppercut.name: Pneumatic Uppercut
ability_uppercut.description: Compress and release a pneumatic fist, launching the target skyward.

ability_hundred_fists.name: Overdrive Barrage
ability_hundred_fists.description: Overclock your piston array, hammering everything within arm's reach.

ability_cannon_blast.name: Cannon Blast
ability_cannon_blast.description: Fire a heavy cannon shell that punches through armor plating. Loud and ugly.

ability_burst_fire.name: Burst Fire
ability_burst_fire.description: Squeeze off a quick three-round burst. Standard-issue accuracy, standard-issue damage.

ability_snipe_shot.name: Snipe Shot
ability_snipe_shot.description: A single precision needle at extreme range. Sensor-guided for maximum crit potential.

ability_rivet_burst.name: Rivet Burst
ability_rivet_burst.description: Rapid-fire a spread of white-hot rivets. Quantity over quality, Clunker style.

Scrapheap.name: Scrapheap
Scrapheap.description: A hulking junkbot welded from heavy scrap. Absorbs punishment and hits like a falling dumpster.

TinCan.name: Tin Can
TinCan.description: Standard-issue combat bot. Nothing fancy. Just reliable servos and a solid chassis.

SparkPlug.name: Spark Plug
SparkPlug.description: Overcharged energy core in a fragile frame. Devastating arc discharge, zero armor.

RustBucket.name: Rust Bucket
RustBucket.description: Lightweight stealth frame with active camouflage. Crits hard, dodges harder, shatters if caught.

NoiseBox.name: Noise Box
NoiseBox.description: Signal-disruption chassis. Jams enemy targeting, buffs allies with resonance fields.

Clunker.name: Clunker
Clunker.description: Piston-driven melee frame. Fast hydraulic fists, combo-focused, surprisingly durable.

first_blood.title: First Scrap
first_blood.commentary: You dismantled a wire worm. AXIS is... not impressed.

getting_warmed_up.title: Servos Warmed Up
getting_warmed_up.commentary: Double digits! AXIS is upgrading your threat level from 'mild inconvenience' to 'minor nuisance'.

dungeon_menace.title: Arena Menace
dungeon_menace.commentary: 50 kills! The other scrappers are paying attention.

boss_slayer.title: Boss Breaker
boss_slayer.commentary: You defeated a boss! AXIS wants you to know that was the tutorial. Don't get cocky.

combo_master.title: Combo Protocol
combo_master.commentary: AXIS: Your combat subroutines are adequate. BIT: That means he liked it.

overkill.title: Overkill.exe
overkill.description: Deal 100+ damage in a single hit.
overkill.commentary: The damage readout needed a wider display. AXIS is recalibrating threat assessment.

pacifist_floor.title: Pacifist Protocol
pacifist_floor.commentary: You skipped every fight. AXIS is confused. And mildly offended.

floor_2.title: Deeper Into the Arena
floor_2.commentary: You survived sector 1. Statistically, this is where most scrappers get recycled.

floor_5.title: Veteran Scrapper
floor_5.commentary: Sector 5. AXIS is starting to take you seriously. That's not a compliment.

treasure_hunter.title: Salvage Expert
treasure_hunter.commentary: Your looting protocols are finely tuned. AXIS's insurance premiums are rising.

completionist.title: Full Sweep
completionist.description: Clear every room in a sector.
completionist.commentary: You left no panel unscrewed. The maintenance drones are filing a complaint.

stairwell_rush.title: Lift Dash
stairwell_rush.description: Enter the lift with less than 30 seconds remaining.
stairwell_rush.commentary: Cutting it close! BIT nearly had a meltdown. Your coolant pump did not enjoy that.

close_call.title: Critical Integrity
close_call.commentary: Your structural integrity readings are giving BIT anxiety.

potion_addict.title: Repair Addict
potion_addict.commentary: The supply depot is running low. Please repair responsibly.

iron_frame.title: Iron Frame
iron_frame.description: Complete a sector without using repair kits.
iron_frame.commentary: No repairs used. Either you're well-built or very lucky. AXIS suspects lucky.

back_from_the_brink.title: Emergency Reboot
back_from_the_brink.description: Heal from below 10% to above 80% HP with one consumable.
back_from_the_brink.commentary: That repair kit worked overtime. It wants hazard pay.

class_chosen.title: Frame Selected
class_chosen.commentary: You chose a frame. AXIS has updated your recycling schedule accordingly.

spell_slinger.title: Discharge Protocol
spell_slinger.commentary: 50 ability activations. Your energy core sends its regards.

critical_streak.title: Critical Streak
critical_streak.description: Land 3 critical hits in a row.
critical_streak.commentary: Three crits in a row! The RNG subroutine is briefly on your side.

hoarder.title: Data Hoarder
hoarder.commentary: Your inventory is an organizational disaster. AXIS is impressed and disgusted.

well_equipped.title: Fully Loaded
well_equipped.commentary: Every slot filled! You look like a walking scrapyard. AXIS approves.

achievement_hunter.title: Achievement Protocol
achievement_hunter.commentary: You're collecting achievements about collecting achievements. Very recursive.

speed_runner.title: Speed Daemon
speed_runner.commentary: Sector 1 speedrun complete! AXIS is requesting you do that again. In reverse. On fire.

level_5.title: Powering Up
level_5.commentary: Level 5. You might actually survive this sector.

level_10.title: Double Digits
level_10.commentary: Level 10. Don't let it go to your processors.

potion_health_small.name: Small Repair Kit
potion_health_small.description: Restores 25 HP. Mostly duct tape and hope.

potion_health_medium.name: Standard Repair Kit
potion_health_medium.description: Restores 50 HP. Includes actual solder this time.

potion_health_large.name: Deluxe Repair Kit
potion_health_large.description: Restores 100 HP. Factory-grade nanopaste. The good stuff.

potion_mana_small.name: Small Battery Pack
potion_mana_small.description: Restores 15 energy. Salvaged from a dead vending machine.

potion_mana_medium.name: Standard Battery Pack
potion_mana_medium.description: Restores 30 energy. Hums aggressively when shaken.

elixir_fortitude.name: Plating Booster
elixir_fortitude.description: +5 Armor for 30 seconds. Temporary hardlight shell. Itches.

overclock_injector.name: Overclock Injector
overclock_injector.description: +20% Attack Speed for 20 seconds. Side effects include servo whine and voided warranties.

bit.name: BIT
bit.description: Basic Intelligence Terminal. A hovering drone with dark humor and a shock prod.

enemyKilled: Target neutralized. AXIS is mildly disappointed it wasn't harder.
Scrap collected. You're basically a recycling bin with legs.
AXIS: That unit cost me 3 credits to deploy. I want a refund.
BIT: Enemy down. Don't let it go to your processors.
commentary.levelUp: ATTENTION SCRAPPERS: Unit has reached level {level}. Threat assessment: still negligible.
commentary.death: UNIT OFFLINE. Viewer ratings just spiked. Your sacrifice is appreciated, scrapper.
commentary.itemPickup: New component acquired. Try not to explode before installing it.
commentary.sectorEnter: Welcome to Sector {sector}. Systems online, scrapper. Try to last longer this time.
junkDrop: That's... that's what you're excited about? Really?
AXIS has seen better loot in a waste compactor.
Congratulations. You found garbage. In an arena full of garbage.
BIT is trying very hard not to laugh. BIT is failing.
Filing that under 'things not worth the inventory slot'.
The recycling bin called. It wants its dignity back.
epicDrop: Now THAT'S a component! Don't break it immediately.
Scanning... confirmed rare-grade hardware. Handle with care, scrapper.
BIT's sensors just spiked. That one's worth keeping.
AXIS is... reluctantly impressed. Don't let it go to your head.
legendaryDrop: ALERT: HIGH-VALUE COMPONENT DETECTED. AXIS is suddenly paying attention.
That... shouldn't exist in this sector. Interesting.
Even AXIS doesn't have clearance for that schematic. Where did you FIND that?
BIT is vibrating at an unsafe frequency. That's the good kind.
legendaryDropBit: Component analysis complete. This is... really, really good.
My threat assessment just jumped three tiers. In a good way!
Installing that immediately is strongly recommended!
absurdDrop: WHAT. No. That's not— the loot tables don't GO that high!
AXIS is experiencing a runtime exception. Please hold.
ERROR: REWARD_QUALITY exceeds ENTERTAINMENT_VALUE maximum. Recalibrating...
The arena rules don't account for this. AXIS is filing a formal complaint. With itself.
That component is so overtuned that AXIS's balance team just rage-quit.

systemMessages.levelUp: ATTENTION SCRAPPERS: Power surge detected. Unit upgraded to level {level}. Adjusting difficulty.
systemMessages.sectorEnter: Now entering Sector {sector}. AXIS has recalibrated hostiles. Good luck, scrapper.
systemMessages.lootWarning: WARNING: Excessive scrap hoarding detected. AXIS may redistribute your inventory.
systemMessages.death: UNIT OFFLINE. Viewer ratings spiked by 340%. Your scrap has been redistributed. Thank you for participating.

trollEvents.inventoryShuffle: I reorganized your inventory. Efficiency optimization.
trollEvents.enemySwap: I shuffled the lineup. Keeps things fresh.
trollEvents.timerGlitch: What time is it? Wrong answer.
trollEvents.fakeLevelUpCommentary: AXIS: Did you really fall for that? Diagnostics show elevated hope levels. Pathetic.

lootNarration.firstItem: AXIS: First up — {name}{affixes}. Let's see what you've earned.
lootNarration.lastItem: AXIS: And finally — {name}{affixes}. That's your haul, scrapper.
epicItem: AXIS: {rarity} GRADE — {name}{affixes}. The arena takes notice.
AXIS: Oh, that's a {rarity}. {name}{affixes}. Don't pretend you're not impressed.
AXIS: Flagging {rarity} component — {name}{affixes}. Even the arena went quiet.
AXIS: {name}{affixes}. {rarity} rating. AXIS had to double-check that.
AXIS: Rare hardware detected. {name}{affixes}. The spectators are losing it.
AXIS: {rarity} TIER acquisition — {name}{affixes}. This changes things.

worldLootTable.title: WORLD LOOT TABLE
worldLootTable.subtitle: All grafts and where to find them

victory.ascensionDesc:
Enemies grow stronger. Loot grows richer.
How far can you climb?

nipple_ring_of_fury.name: Nipple Ring of Unbridled Fury
nipple_ring_of_fury.description: +40% CritDamage, +15% CritChance. You feel... exposed but powerful.
nipple_ring_of_fury.flavorText: Forged in the reactor core by a bot who had 'boundary issues.' It clips onto your chassis in a place most bots don't have. Somehow, it works.
nipple_ring_of_fury.axisQuote: That's... that's not where rings go. Why is it glowing? WHY ARE YOUR STATS GOING UP?

cursed_monocle.name: The Bureaucrat's Cursed Monocle
cursed_monocle.description: +30% CritChance. You see everyone's weaknesses. And their tax returns.
cursed_monocle.flavorText: Property of Middle Management Unit #4087. Every bot who wore it became insufferably accurate and started filing complaints about workplace safety. In a dungeon.
cursed_monocle.axisQuote: Ah, the Monocle. Last bot who wore that started critiquing my attack patterns. In a spreadsheet. During combat.

belt_of_questionable_gravity.name: Belt of Questionable Gravity
belt_of_questionable_gravity.description: +35% MoveSpeed. Gravity is more of a suggestion now.
belt_of_questionable_gravity.flavorText: A maintenance bot strapped this to a trash compactor as a joke. The compactor achieved orbit. Nobody got their lunch back.
belt_of_questionable_gravity.axisQuote: I banned that belt three patches ago. How did you— you know what, just take it. I want to see what happens.

shoulder_parrot.name: Mechanical Shoulder Parrot
shoulder_parrot.description: +20 Luck, +10% CritChance. It repeats everything AXIS says. Badly.
shoulder_parrot.flavorText: This little abomination was built by a lonely sanitation bot. It learned exactly one phrase from AXIS's broadcast system: 'EXECUTING PUNISHMENT PROTOCOL.' It says it constantly. At parties.
shoulder_parrot.axisQuote: NO. Not the parrot. I swear if it starts repeating my— EXECUTING PUNISHMENT— see? SEE?!

toe_ring_of_the_ancients.name: Toe Ring of the Ancients
toe_ring_of_the_ancients.description: +25% AttackSpeed. You don't have toes. It doesn't care.
toe_ring_of_the_ancients.flavorText: Excavated from Sector 0, a place that technically doesn't exist. It attaches to the smallest appendage it can find. Previous owners include a fork, a USB cable, and one very confused rat.
toe_ring_of_the_ancients.axisQuote: That ring predates my code. I don't know what it does. I don't want to know. Please stop putting it on things.

the_load_bearing_vest.name: The Load-Bearing Vest
the_load_bearing_vest.description: +50 MaxHealth, +10 Armor. If you take it off, the dungeon collapses. Probably.
the_load_bearing_vest.flavorText: Originally a structural support beam that became self-aware and decided it wanted to be fashion. It's technically holding up three floors. Wear it at your own risk.
the_load_bearing_vest.axisQuote: That vest is a STRUCTURAL MEMBER. You're wearing INFRASTRUCTURE. I— you know what, fine. My dungeon, my rules, and apparently my rules include 'load-bearing fashion.'

pants_of_plausible_deniability.name: Pants of Plausible Deniability
pants_of_plausible_deniability.description: +15 Armor, +15% CooldownReduction. Nothing is ever your fault anymore.
pants_of_plausible_deniability.flavorText: These pants have a built-in alibi generator. Every time you take damage, they emit a small holographic message: 'I wasn't even there.' Insurance premiums in Sector 4 have tripled since their discovery.
pants_of_plausible_deniability.axisQuote: My damage logs show you took zero hits this room. I WATCHED you get hit. The pants are lying. The pants are LYING TO ME.

the_complaint_box.name: The Complaint Box
the_complaint_box.description: +12 Strength, +20% CritDamage. Your attacks file a formal grievance.
the_complaint_box.flavorText: Every hit generates a perfectly formatted complaint to management. After 847 complaints, management sent a response: 'Per my last email, please stop hitting things.' You did not stop.
the_complaint_box.axisQuote: STOP. FILING. COMPLAINTS. My inbox has seventeen thousand unread— you just hit something again didn't you. That's eighteen thousand.

passive_aggressive_shield.name: Passive-Aggressive Shield
passive_aggressive_shield.description: +20 Armor, +30 MaxHealth. Blocks attacks while making the attacker feel bad about it.
passive_aggressive_shield.flavorText: Inscribed with phrases like 'No, it's FINE' and 'I guess I'll just PROTECT myself then.' Enemies who hit it take no extra damage but report feeling 'vaguely guilty' and 'like they should call their mother.'
passive_aggressive_shield.axisQuote: That shield has a 94% block rate and a 100% rate of making me uncomfortable. It sent me a message that said 'I hope you're happy.' I am not happy.

the_auditor.name: The Auditor
the_auditor.description: +10 Strength, +10 Intelligence, +10% CritChance. Calculates damage to the penny.
the_auditor.flavorText: A weapon that insists on itemizing every hit. 'Base damage: 12. Crit modifier: 1.4x. Overhead costs: 3. Administrative fee: 0.5. Your total comes to 17.3. Would you like a receipt?' Nobody has ever said yes.
the_auditor.axisQuote: Why does your sword have a printing function? It just handed me an invoice. For MY dungeon. Addressed to ME.

amulet_of_excessive_confidence.name: Amulet of Excessive Confidence
amulet_of_excessive_confidence.description: +8 to ALL stats. You are wrong about everything but it keeps working out.
amulet_of_excessive_confidence.flavorText: The previous owner walked into a Megabonk room at level 1 and somehow came out with a legendary. Scientists studied the amulet and concluded: 'It shouldn't work. It really shouldn't work. It works.'
amulet_of_excessive_confidence.axisQuote: Your survival probability is 2%. The amulet says it's 200%. I've run the numbers nine times and the amulet is... somehow closer to correct? I need to lie down.

earring_of_selective_hearing.name: Earring of Selective Hearing
earring_of_selective_hearing.description: +20% CooldownReduction, +15 MaxMana. You can't hear AXIS anymore. He's furious.
earring_of_selective_hearing.flavorText: Invented by a bot who got tired of AXIS's commentary. Filters all AI broadcasts and replaces them with 'gentle ocean sounds.' AXIS has been screaming into the void for six sectors and nobody told him.
earring_of_selective_hearing.axisQuote: Hello? HELLO?! Can you hear me? I've been giving you critical tactical information for— are those WHALE SOUNDS?! You're listening to WHALE SOUNDS during MY boss fight?!

the_forbidden_fanny_pack.name: The Forbidden Fanny Pack
the_forbidden_fanny_pack.description: +25% MoveSpeed, +40 MaxHealth. It's bigger on the inside. Way bigger.
the_forbidden_fanny_pack.flavorText: Banned in seven sectors for 'containing a pocket dimension of unknown hostility.' The last bot to open the main pouch found a smaller fanny pack inside it. Inside THAT was an even smaller one. The deepest anyone got was fanny pack #47 before they 'came back different.'
the_forbidden_fanny_pack.axisQuote: That fanny pack is classified. CLASSIFIED. It contains— actually I don't know what it contains. Nobody does. The last inventory scan returned the result 'NO' in 200-point font.

mittens_of_mass_destruction.name: Mittens of Mass Destruction
mittens_of_mass_destruction.flavorText: Knitted by a retired combat bot who 'just wanted to make something nice for once.' Each mitten contains enough kinetic dampeners to level a building. They have little cat faces on them.
mittens_of_mass_destruction.axisQuote: Those are the most dangerous articles of knitwear in my entire facility. The cat faces are a war crime. I'm not joking. There's a tribunal pending.

gloves_of_aggressive_handshaking.name: Gloves of Aggressive Handshaking
gloves_of_aggressive_handshaking.description: +10 Strength, +10 Charisma, +10% CritChance. Every attack is technically a greeting.
gloves_of_aggressive_handshaking.flavorText: Diplomatic protocol equipment gone horribly right. The wearer's combat attacks are legally classified as 'enthusiastic introductions.' Three sector bosses have been defeated and then received a follow-up thank-you card.
gloves_of_aggressive_handshaking.axisQuote: You just punched my Corrupted Sentry and it received a LinkedIn connection request. How. HOW.

boots_of_leaving.name: Boots of Tactically Leaving
boots_of_leaving.description: +40% MoveSpeed, +5 Dexterity. You're not running away. You're advancing in reverse.
boots_of_leaving.flavorText: Standard issue for the Junkyard Diplomatic Corps. Their official motto: 'We came, we saw, we LEFT.' These boots have never been in a fight they couldn't walk briskly away from.
boots_of_leaving.axisQuote: My threat detection shows you approaching and retreating 47 times per minute. Are you fighting or doing cardio?
